title: listing
description: a published design release offered for sale. binds to exactly one release version; no client-side pricing.

release_id.description: references design-release.release_id. the listing's geometry, metals, sizes, and castability come from this release only.

name.description: listing title, creator-provided. distinct from the design name if desired.

description.description: optional listing description. markdown formatting allowed.

status.description: locked_drop = scheduled publication with countdown preclock. unlock is server-enforced.

scheduled_publish_at.description: required when status=locked_drop. the server unlocks to published at this timestamp.

model.description: creator_net_fixed: creator sets net earnings, operations computes retail. retail_fixed: creator sets retail, operations validates margin.

base_amount_cents.description: the base amount in cents (creator net or retail, per model). per-variant pricing can differ via variant_overrides.

variant_overrides.description: optional per-variant pricing. key = metal or size identifier from the release. if absent, base_amount_cents applies.

pricing_intent.description: pricing intent only. actual retail price and split are computed server-side by the trusted pricing service.

collections.description: collection_ids this listing belongs to. collections are creator-owned public groups.

style_tags.description: style tags from the offerings vocabulary. used for discovery resolution. no freeform tags.

is_featured.description: creator-controlled featured flag. featured listings appear first on the creator public page overview.

made_to_order.description: true = manufactured on demand. false = in-stock inventory (future, requires stock management).

published_at.description: timestamp when status first became published. null if never published.
